watchlist_releases.body:
# Newton v1.8.0

Newton v1.8.0 is a feature release following v1.7.0. It introduces the experimental Steel solver for articulated rigid bodies and adds routed tendons and richer deformable simulation and rendering. If you are upgrading from a previous version, review the upgrade guidance below.

For the complete list of changes, see the [changelog](https://github.com/newton-physics/newton/blob/release-1.8/CHANGELOG.md#180---2026-11-12).

## Highlights

- **New experimental solver: [SolverSteel](https://newton-physics.github.io/newton/latest/api/_generated/newton.solvers.SolverSteel.html).** Developed in collaboration with [Skild AI](https://www.skild.ai/), Steel targets high-throughput, memory-efficient simulation for contact-rich reinforcement learning. Its matrix-free projected Gauss-Seidel solver handles environments containing multiple rigid bodies and articulations, with support for run-to-run determinism, island-based sleeping, and patch-based Coulomb friction. (#4522, #5150)
- **Experimental: [massless routed tendons](https://github.com/newton-physics/newton/blob/release-1.8/docs/tendons.md).** Simulate compliant routes through anchors, pinholes and rollers, including capstan friction and dynamic routing, in XPBD and VBD without discretizing a massive cable. (#4132)
